composition.serve_who: This sheet (108-01-520-001 "Bilge & Fire System Schematic") documents the vessel's combined bilge and fire main systems end-to-end: fire hydrant stations fore and aft, seawater fire pumps (diesel + electric), the fireline running the length of the hull along the port sheer, main/auxiliary bilge pumps serving six sump zones (lazarette, midship, engine room, mast area, sail locker, ESS enclosure), the oily-water separator/filter path to portable oil storage, and all associated strainers, non-return/relief valves, motorized valves, alarms and anti-siphon protection. Evidence: title block "BILGE & FIRE SYSTEM SCHEMATIC", zone labels (LAZARETTE BILGE AREA, ENGINE ROOM AUX BILGE PUMP, MAST AREA AUX BILGE PUMP, SAIL LOCKER BILGE AREA), fire hydrant/hose symbols at both ends, fireline (red) traced continuously frame-to-frame, and the BOM table listing all pumps/valves as one integrated bilge+fire parts list. All equipment on this sheet maps to register node group 520 (Bilge and fire system) except the main engine raw-water/exhaust separator reference (515/610, out of scope, only referenced by note) and general arrangement room labels (310, discarded as non-plumbing).

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Main Bilge Pump (Feit VA 40B, 24V DC, item 001) — system-level bilge/fire schematic
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 001 explicitly 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' Feit VA 40B 24VDC centrifugal pump; register node 520-main-bilge-pump names Gianneschi ACB431B but sheet's own BOM ties item 001 to Feit VA40B — noted as uncertainty. Two instances shown: fwd bilge area (near frame G) and aft bilge area (near frame B), each with local start + remote start pushbuttons top of sheet.

functions.label: Fwd/Aft main bilge pumping
functions.what_it_does: Removes standing bilge water from the main bilge line (metallic, cyan) running the length of the hull, drawing from the strumbox pickups in each sump and discharging overboard above DWL; two units cover fwd and aft halves of the vessel.

flow_scenarios.path: Sump strumbox (non-return integrated) → main bilge line (cyan, sea54) → Main Bilge Pump → NRV → overboard discharge above DWL
Local start pushbutton (green triangle symbol, 'MAIN BILGE PUMP LOCAL START') at pump station energizes pump directly
Remote start pushbutton ('MAIN BILGE PUMP REMOTE START', top of sheet) energizes pump from bridge/control station
Vega Vegapoint 21 capacitive switch (item 007) in sump trips 'Bilge Alarm' indicator at control panel (CP) when level rises, independent of pump run state

functions.dry_data: Feit VA40B, 24V DC, 300 l/min (18 m³/h), 0.75 kW, 17 m max head (per Pump Data table); BOM item 001, qty 2, weight 22kg each

equipment_groups.sheet_region: Upper plan view frames G–B (fwd/aft bilge area callouts); lower schematic bilge lines near frames G, F, B

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Auxiliary Bilge Pumps (Whale Gulper 320, 24V DC, item 003)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 003 'AUXILIARY BILGE PUMP' Whale Gulper 2054, matches register node 520-aux-bilge-pumps (mast + eng room); sheet shows three instances (engine room aux, mast area aux, sail locker aux) all sharing same role.

functions.label: Engine room auxiliary bilge pumping
functions.what_it_does: Secondary/local bilge removal for engine room sump, backing up the oily bilge filter path or handling routine seepage.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine room sump strumbox → E-R aux bilge pump → mw25 PVC discharge → joins oily bilge filter (item 004) manifold or direct overboard per 3-way valve (014) position
Sump float/level switch trips 'Bilge Alarm Aux Pump' (item 025) at CP

functions.dry_data: Whale Gulper 320, 24V DC, 19 l/min (1.1 m³/h), 0.1 kW, 3 bar (per Pump Data table); BOM item 003 qty 3, 2.2kg each

functions.label: Mast area auxiliary bilge pumping
functions.what_it_does: Drains mast area sump including fwd deck locker drain water via suction manifold.

flow_scenarios.path: Mast area sump + fwd deck locker drain (mw25 pipe, min 800mm above DWL) → mast aux bilge pump suction manifold → aux bilge pump → discharge overboard/oily filter branch
Level switch trips Bilge Alarm at CP

functions.dry_data: Same Whale Gulper 320 spec as above

functions.label: Sail locker auxiliary bilge pumping
functions.what_it_does: Drains sail locker bilge area at fwd end of vessel.

flow_scenarios.path: Sail locker sump strumbox → aux bilge pump → discharge overboard above DWL near fwd stowage
Level switch (item 025-0x) trips Bilge Alarm at CP

equipment_groups.sheet_region: Lower schematic, frames I/H (engine room aux), F (mast area aux), and far right near frame A (sail locker aux)

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Fire Pump — Diesel (Aussie Pumps LF48 / Yanmar L48, item 002) 'crash pump'
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 002 'DIESEL FIRE PUMP' Yanmar L48 engine driving Aussie Pumps LF48; matches register node 520-diesel-fire-pump described as 'crash pump' Aussie Pumps/Yanmar L48.

functions.label: Emergency/backup fireline pressurization (independent of ship's electrical power)
functions.what_it_does: Diesel-engine-driven raw water pump supplies the fireline main independent of DC power, located aft near lazarette/tender garage, manual pull-start.

flow_scenarios.path: Seawater pickup (aft) → seawater strainer → Diesel Fire Pump (manual pull-start) → NRV → fireline (red, sea42 metallic) running fwd along port sheer → hydrant stations
Priming line from fresh water supply (ref DWG 108-01-510-001) primes pump before start
'DIESEL BACKUP BILGE PUMP' / 'AFT FIRE PUMP' remote start symbols at top of sheet indicate remote annunciation, actual start is manual pull-start at pump

functions.dry_data: Aussie Pumps LF48 (Yanmar YDH50 engine), 715 l/min (42.9 m³/h), 3.6 kW, max head 37m (Pump Data table); BOM item 002, qty 2, 22kg each

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 024 'ELECTRIC FIRE PUMP' Gianneschi ACB431 24V 1.5kW matches register node 520-fire-pump (Gianneschi ACB431B).

functions.label: Primary electric fireline pressurization (fwd)
functions.what_it_does: 24V DC electric pump supplying the fireline main from the fwd end, backing up/complementing the diesel crash pump.

flow_scenarios.path: Seawater pickup (fwd) → seawater strainer → Electric Fire Pump → fireline (red, sea42) → aft along port sheer → hydrant stations / anti-siphon manifold breather to stbd E-R vent box
'ELECTRIC FIRE PUMP' remote start icon top of sheet + local start capability

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bilge Valves (Burkert motorized ball valves, items 016/017) and manual ball valves (items 010/011/014/015/023)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM items 016 (Burkert electric rotary actuator) and 017 (Burkert motor-actuated ball valve 316SS 2") explicitly match register node 520-bilge-valves 'Burkert'; grouped with the other manual valve types serving the same bilge/fire switching role since no separate node exists for manual valves.

functions.label: Zone bilge suction selection / isolation (motorized)
functions.what_it_does: Motor-actuated 2-way ball valves allow remote selection/isolation of bilge suction from aft/lazarette area, engine room, and sail locker area sumps into the main bilge line.

flow_scenarios.path: Sump line → motor-actuated valve (016/017, e.g. 'FOR E-R', 'FOR AFT AREA', 'FOR SAIL LOCKER AREA') → main bilge line → pump suction
Valve closed, zone isolated from main bilge line to prevent cross-flooding between compartments

functions.dry_data: Burkert 00589199 actuator + 96702091 valve, 5.6kg/28kg total (016), 3.5kg/17.5kg total (017); 5 instances each (016-01..05, 017-01..05)

functions.label: Manual bilge/fire line valving (isolation, overboard discharge, 3-way switching)
functions.what_it_does: Manual ball valves isolate branches, direct bilge discharge overboard, and 3-way valves switch flow between oily filter path and direct discharge / portable oil tank fill.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge line → 1½" or 2" ball valve (items 010/011, normally closed) opened → overboard above DWL
3-way valve (item 014, L-port 1") positioned to route engine room bilge → oily removal cartridge filter (004) → portable oil storage tank
3-way valve (014/015) positioned to bypass filter, routing bilge directly to aux pump suction manifold

key_components: G I Trade Options 3-way L-port valve 1"/2" (items 014/015)
Mini ball valve ½" (item 023) at seawater pickup/priming branches
functions.dry_data: Guidi 2070 series NC ball valves 0.18-1.98kg; BAJ023/GIT136 3-way valves 1-3.5kg

equipment_groups.sheet_region: Distributed across lower schematic at each sump zone (lazarette, midship, engine room, mast area, sail locker) and fireline branches

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bilge Level Alarm Switches (Vega Vegapoint 21, item 007; RWB Sensors float switch, item 025)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 007 'HIGH LEVEL BILGE ALARM SWITCH' Vega Vegapoint 21 directly matches register node 520-vega-bilge-level-sensors. Auxiliary pump float switches (item 025) grouped here as no separate node exists for them.

functions.label: High-level bilge alarming per sump zone
functions.what_it_does: Capacitive level switch in each of six sumps (lazarette, midship, engine room, mast area, sail locker, ESS enclosure) triggers a 'Bilge Alarm' indicator light at control panel when water rises to set level, independent of which pump is running.

flow_scenarios.path: No alarm signal
Vegapoint 21 capacitive sensor (007-01..0x) → signal to Main Control Panel (CP) → 'Bilge Alarm' lamp lit at respective sump station

functions.dry_data: Vega Vegapoint 21, capacitive level switch with IO-Link transistor, 0.25kg/1.25kg total; qty 6 (one per sump incl. ESS enclosure)

functions.label: Auxiliary pump low-level float alarming
functions.what_it_does: Float switch confirms/alarms auxiliary bilge pump sump levels at engine room, mast area, and sail locker locations.

flow_scenarios.path: RWB Sensors float switch 117716 (025-01..04) → 'Bilge Alarm Aux Pump' indicator at CP

functions.dry_data: RWB Sensors 117716, float switch, 316 N.O., 0.25kg/1kg total; qty 4

functions.label: ESS enclosure coolant leak alarming (adjacent function on same sump)
functions.what_it_does: Separate coolant leak alarm sensor near ESS enclosure sump distinct from bilge water alarm, flags coolant intrusion into bilge.

flow_scenarios.path: Coolant leak sensor (007-0x variant) → 'Coolant Leak Alarm' indicator at CP

functions.dry_data: Uncertain exact model — labelled as variant of item 007 series

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Whale Pumps — Bilge Pickup Strumboxes (item 006) and General Bilge/Fire Fittings (items 004,005,008,009,012,013,018-022)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: No dedicated node exists for strumboxes/strainers/relief valves/hydrant hardware; grouped under 520-whale-pumps as the closest available Bilge and fire system node for miscellaneous BOM items not separately named, since Whale is the aux pump brand and this node sits in same system class.

functions.label: Bilge suction strainer/check function at each sump
functions.what_it_does: Strumbox with integrated non-return valve sits at the low point of each sump, straining debris from bilge water before it enters suction piping and preventing backflow into the sump.

flow_scenarios.path: Sump water → strumbox strainer/NRV (item 006, one per sump: lazarette, midship, engine room, mast area, sail locker, ESS enclosure) → suction line to bilge pump

functions.dry_data: Central Boating Amazone Strumbox 29290-0010, integrated non-return valve, qty 6

functions.label: Oily bilge water treatment before discharge
functions.what_it_does: Cartridge filter removes oil from engine room bilge discharge before it reaches portable oil storage tank, keeping oily waste separate from overboard discharge.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine room bilge (via 3-way valve 014 selection) → Wavestream oily removal cartridge filter (004-01) → to portable oil storage tank

functions.label: Seawater/bilge line straining (fireline supply)
functions.what_it_does: 2" strainers protect fire pumps and bilge pumps from debris ingestion at seawater pickups and fireline branches.

flow_scenarios.path: Seawater pickup → Guidi ART1162 strainer (item 005) → pump suction

functions.label: Fireline overpressure protection
functions.what_it_does: Relief valve set at 3 bar protects the fireline main from overpressure at both aft and fwd ends near port sheer.

flow_scenarios.path: No relief flow, fireline at operating pressure
Fireline pressure exceeds 3 bar → relief valve (008-01/02) opens → vents/relieves to protect line

functions.dry_data: 3 bar set pressure, item 008, 1.5kg/1.5kg total, qty 2 (aft and fwd)

functions.label: Backflow prevention on fireline/bilge branches
functions.what_it_does: 2½" non-return valves prevent reverse flow in fireline and bilge branch lines at multiple points along the run.

flow_scenarios.path: Valve open, flow passes toward fireline/bilge main
Valve closes, blocking backflow

functions.dry_data: Guidi ART1532 2½" NRV, item 009, qty 5 (009-01..05), 1.5kg/7.5kg total

functions.label: Anti-siphon protection for bilge discharge above DWL
functions.what_it_does: Anti-siphon manifold and siphonbreak valves prevent unintended siphoning of seawater back into the bilge system through overboard discharge lines above DWL; breather vents into stbd E-R vent box.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge discharge line → anti-siphon manifold (012-01) → overboard above DWL (min 700mm above DWL)
Siphonbreak valve (013-01, Guidi ART1250) admits air to break any siphon action, breather ref DWG 108-01-508-001

functions.dry_data: Custom 316L/S steel manifold (item 012) 2.5kg/2.5kg; Guidi ART1250 siphonbreak (item 013) 0.18kg/1kg

functions.label: Fire hydrant stations (fwd and aft)
functions.what_it_does: Fixed fire hydrant valves with coiled hose and nozzle provide manual firefighting capability at aft and fwd stowage stations; max reach of 18m fire hose shown by dashed red arcs covering aft guest/crew and fwd guest areas.

flow_scenarios.path: Hydrant valve closed, hose coiled in stowage
Fireline (pressurized by diesel or electric fire pump) → hydrant valve (018-01/02) opened → fire hose (019) → nozzle (020) → spray at point of use, max reach 18m from hydrant

functions.dry_data: Fire hydrant valve item 018, 2.2kg/4.4kg; fire hose item 019, 7kg/14kg; nozzle item 020, 4kg/8kg; qty 2 stations

functions.label: Water mist spray / deck wash tap points
functions.what_it_does: Gardena-type tap connectors feed water mist spray heads (tender garage, fwd stowage) and portable fill points off the fireline.

flow_scenarios.path: Fireline → Gardena tap connector (021-01..04) → water mist spray head (022-01/02) or portable oil/water tank fill

functions.dry_data: Gardena connector item 021, 0.2kg/0.8kg; spray head item 022, qty per instance not weighted separately

equipment_groups.sheet_region: Distributed across full lower schematic; hydrant stations and hose reach arcs shown in upper plan view at frames L/K/J (aft) and H/G/F (fwd)

facts: Fireline main (red, sea42 metallic hose, ISO 7840 Marine Fuel A2 NBR rubber steel spiral, 38mm/51mm OD) runs continuously along port sheer from aft fire pump station to fwd fire pump station, tapped at multiple frames for hydrants and branches.
Main bilge line (cyan, sea54 metallic, CuNiFe 90/10, 42mm/54mm OD) runs parallel length of hull connecting all sump zones to main bilge pumps.
PVC/flex auxiliary bilge piping (mw25, PVC marine water 25mm) connects aux pumps, oily filter, and deck locker drain.
Freshwater priming supply (dashed blue, 15mm PEX) references separate DWG 108-01-510-001 feeding fire pump primes.

Frame stations labeled 11 through 1 with watertight bulkheads at G, F, E, D, B, A used as sheet reference/citation grid; zones: Lazarette 3835mm, Aft Guest+Crew 10178mm, Engine Room 3077mm, Fwd Guest 10309mm, Sail Locker 3425mm.

Drawing 108-01-520-001, Rev B, 'BILGE & FIRE SYSTEM SCHEMATIC', approved 03 Oct 2022; references companion drawings 108-01-504-002 (thru-hull below DWL) and 108-01-508-001 (vent box), 108-01-515-001 (exhaust water separator), 108-01-510-001 (freshwater supply).

uncertainties: BOM item 001 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' is listed with make/model Feit VA40B, but register node 520-main-bilge-pump is documented as Gianneschi ACB431B — sheet data conflicts with register; both retained, flagged as discrepancy, not resolved.
Coolant Leak Alarm near ESS Enclosure sump (labelled variant of item 007) has no clear distinct BOM row/model — exact identity uncertain.

3-way valve position logic (item 014/015) for oily filter vs. direct/bypass routing is inferred from adjacent labels ('TO PORTABLE OIL STORAGE TANK') but exact valve-position-to-path mapping is not explicitly keyed on the sheet.
Main engine raw water pump / exhaust water separator (Cummins QSB4.5) is only referenced by note on this sheet, not detailed — treated as out-of-scope cross-reference, not composed here.

ESS enclosure bilge pickup (ADDED per Rev B note) — exact pump serving it not clearly labeled beyond generic strumbox 006-08 and seawater strainer; assumed part of nearby aux/main bilge line but not fully traced.
